title: Arena Blanca | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked within the exclusive gated community of Vizcaya on the peaceful west end of 30A, Arena Blanca offers an elevated blend of Spanish-style elegance and effortless beachside living. With stunning Gulf views, a personal elevator serving all levels, and a one-minute walk to sugar-white sands, this beautifully appointed home sleeps 12 and is ideal for multi-family getaways. High ceilings, calming interiors, and thoughtful design details flow throughout, while the chef’s kitchen, with its Thermador appliances and generous island, serves as the heart of the home, perfect for gathering over shared meals and conversation. Every home is well equipped with linens on each bed, as well as an extra set for any sleeper sofas that may be in the home. Each bathroom is stocked appropriately with bath towels, hand towels, wash cloths, and bath mats to accommodate the sleeping capacity of the home. There are starter sets of soap, detergent, dish soap, and toilet paper there for your convenience. Kitchens are each stocked with enough dishes, serving pieces, glassware, and all the other kitchen necessities to prepare meals during the guests stay. We provide a starter set of laundry detergent for our guests to use when they arrive.
rooms_guidance: Bedroom 1: Two Double Over Double Bunks
